name: Crown Towers Sydney
positioning: Luxury hotel with a waterfront location in Sydney's Barangaroo precinct, with harbour views, an outdoor pool and Crown Spa
best_for: Travelers who want harbour views in central Sydney
Corporate and leisure guests wanting a base a few minutes' walk from the CBD

facts.text: Crown Towers Sydney rises above the Barangaroo precinct.
The hotel has a waterfront location.
The hotel's address is 1 Barangaroo Avenue, Sydney.
The hotel is a few minutes' walk from Sydney's CBD.
The Barangaroo precinct around the hotel connects to parklands, laneway bars, public artworks and bay views.
Each room has modern decor that reflects the hotel's harbourside setting.
The resort has restaurants, bars and luxury retail stores.
Restaurants at Crown include Nobu, a'Mare and Woodcut.
The hotel caters to both corporate and leisure guests.

highlights.text: Guests can see panoramic views of the Sydney Harbour Bridge and Opera House from the outdoor pool.
The Crown Towers Villas come with butler service, luxury amenities and Sydney harbour views.
Rooms have framed views of Sydney's skyline.
The Barangaroo precinct around the hotel connects to parklands, laneway bars, public artworks and bay views.

considerations.text: This is a city hotel in the bustling Barangaroo precinct, a few minutes' walk from the CBD, rather than a secluded retreat.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
